content.text: Need to check which import sources each file uses.

input.command: for f in packages/app-store/hitpay/lib/PaymentService.ts packages/app-store/hitpay/components/EventTypeAppSettingsInterface.tsx packages/app-store/btcpayserver/components/EventTypeAppSettingsInterface.tsx packages/app-store/stripepayment/components/EventTypeAppSettingsInterface.tsx packages/app-store/paypal/components/EventTypeAppSettingsInterface.tsx; do echo "== $f"; rg -n -B6 -A3 "^\s*convertToSmallestCurrencyUnit,|^import.*convertToSmall" $f | rg "from|convertTo"; done; sed -n 1,30p packages/app-store/hitpay/lib/currencyConversions.ts; rg -n "currencyConversions|currencyOptions|import" packages/app-store/hitpay/lib/PaymentService.test.ts packages/app-store/paypal/lib/Paypal.test.ts | rg -i "currency"

content.text:
Five files import `convertToSmallestCurrencyUnit` from `@calcom/lib/currencyConversions` (the definition in `packages/lib/currencyConversions.ts`) and call it:

- `packages/features/bookings/lib/handlePayment.ts` calls it on the add-ons price at line 161.
- `packages/app-store/hitpay/lib/PaymentService.ts` calls it at line 160.
- `packages/app-store/hitpay/components/EventTypeAppSettingsInterface.tsx` calls it at line 88.
- `packages/app-store/stripepayment/components/EventTypeAppSettingsInterface.tsx` calls it at line 109.
- `packages/app-store/paypal/components/EventTypeAppSettingsInterface.tsx` calls it at line 80.

Some files that contain the name don't use the `packages/lib` function, so I left them out:

- **`packages/app-store/hitpay/lib/currencyConversions.ts`** defines its own function with the same name. Nothing in the hitpay code imports it, because `PaymentService.ts` and the hitpay settings component both import from `@calcom/lib/currencyConversions`.
- **`packages/app-store/btcpayserver/lib/currencyOptions.ts`** also defines its own copy. The btcpayserver `EventTypeAppSettingsInterface.tsx` imports that copy through `../lib/currencyOptions`, not the `packages/lib` one.
- **`packages/app-store/hitpay/lib/PaymentService.test.ts`** and **`packages/app-store/paypal/lib/Paypal.test.ts`** only mention the function in comments. Neither imports or calls it. I found no other test files that reference it.
